  {D : A → B} {f : AddMonoidAlgebra R' A}, AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (-f) = AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D f
items.informal_description: For any element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R'[A] $, the supremum of the degrees $ D(a) $ for $ a $ in the support of $ -f $ is equal to the supremum of the degrees $ D(a) $ for $ a $ in the support of $ f $, i.e., $ \sup\{D(a) \mid a \in \text{supp}(-f)\} = \sup\{D(a) \mid a \in \text{supp}(f)\} $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of the degree of support in an additive monoid algebra
items.type:

    {B : Type u_5} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] → [OrderBot B] → (A → B) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → B
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function returns the supremum of the degrees $ D(a) $ for all $ a $ in the support of $ f $, where the support consists of the elements of $ A $ where $ f $ is non-zero. The supremum is computed with respect to the given degree function $ D $ on $ A $.

items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Vanishing of coefficients outside the supremum degree in additive monoid algebras
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {a : A}, ¬D a ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p → p a = 0
items.informal_description: For any element $ p \in R[A] $ in an additive monoid algebra over a semiring $ R $, and for any $ a \in A $, if the degree $ D(a) $ is not less than or equal to the supremum degree $ \sup\{D(b) \mid b \in \text{supp}(p)\} $ of $ p $, then the coefficient $ p(a) $ is zero. Here, $ \text{supp}(p) $ denotes the support of $ p $, i.e., the set of $ b \in A $ where $ p(b) \neq 0 $.

items.informal_name: Sup-Degree of Subtraction is Bounded by Sup-Degree of Operands
items.type:
∀ {R' : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Ring R'] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R' A},
  AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (f - g) ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D f ⊔ AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D g
items.informal_description: For any elements $ f $ and $ g $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R'[A] $, the supremum degree of $ f - g $ with respect to the degree function $ D $ is less than or equal to the supremum of the degrees of $ f $ and $ g $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Element in Support Achieving Supremum Degree in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} (D : A → B), p ≠ 0 → ∃ a ∈ p.support, AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = D a
items.informal_description: For any non-zero element $ p $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, there exists an element $ a $ in the support of $ p $ such that the supremum degree $ \sup\{D(a) \mid a \in \text{support}(p)\} $ is equal to $ D(a) $, where $ D $ is a degree function on the additive monoid $ M $.
